meta.parties: Tambipillai Et Al v. Nagalingam Et Al

rules.statement: Under the Tesawalamai, property inherited by a daughter from her mother (who had dowry property) would devolve on the mother's nearest relatives, which in this case were the children of Theivanipillai's sisters.
rules.supporting_quote: "Thus, the plaintiff became entitled to one-sixth share. The question was fully argued on both sides, and a mass of authorities has been cited, but the only case in point is the one I have just referred to."
